acceptedFixes: final output reserved with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW in a root-protected mode-0700 directory
one output descriptor carries write, digest, ownership and inode verification
pre-handoff failures remove only the created inode and fsync the directory
unsupported atomic flags fail closed without rename or link fallback

blockingFinding.summary: After directory ownership handoff succeeds, a fallible descriptor close can still throw. The function then reports failure and returns no receipt while the formal output remains committed.
requiredCorrection: close and confirm the output descriptor before directory ownership handoff while rollback remains root-protected
make successful directory fchown the explicit irreversible commit point
do not convert post-commit directory descriptor close failure into a failed transaction without receipt
prove pre-handoff output close failure and directory fchown failure leave no output or receipt
prove post-handoff directory close injection returns a consistent successful receipt
prove cleanup path replacement never unlinks an unrelated inode
